verdicts.decision_note: The client sets the software-controlled motor-speed ceiling to 1500 RPM; no prior attribute becomes stale.

The client changes the motor ceiling to 3000 RPM and confirms adjustable operation from slow mixing through higher-speed frothing without routine maximum-speed use; no separate obsolete key requires removal.
The generic statement that everything functions does not specifically claim that variable-speed adjustment was implemented or exercised, and the client subsequently requests a demonstration.
